subject: Hosted API evaluation follow-up — quickstart, endpoints, rate limits
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Chris Turner <chris.turner@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API evaluation follow-up — quickstart, endpoints, rate limits

Hi Chris — thanks again for hopping on the demo today. Really appreciate you and the team walking through the PoC goals. Quick recap + next steps so we don’t lose momentum: 

1) PoC goals we discussed
- 1k-2k monthly active users in the first phase, expected peaks at ~150 concurrent requests during business hours
- Primary requirements: sub-500ms median latency for short prompts, ability to stream partial responses to the UI, and strict PHI handling (SOC 2 / data retention controls)

2) Hosted API quickstart
- Attached is our quickstart guide (redwood-quickstart.pdf) — includes sample requests, SDK snippets (Node/Python), and a quick streaming example.
- Quick test endpoint (sandbox): https://api.sandbox.redwood.ai/v1/generate (use the trial key in the guide).

3) Endpoints & streaming
- Standard generation endpoint: POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
- Chat/streaming: we support SSE and chunked HTTP streaming — examples in the quickstart.

4) Rate limits & trial increases
- Default Hosted API rate limit: 60 requests/sec per API key and soft token limits of 200k tokens/min for trial accounts.
- We can temporarily increase limits for a PoC (we often enable a time-boxed bump to 200 req/sec for evaluation) — let me know desired burst/concurrency and we can queue that with infra.

5) Data & compliance
- By default hosted requests are encrypted in transit and at rest. We retain logs for 30 days for debugging unless you request a different retention policy for the PoC.
- Attached is a short SOC 2 summary (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf). For long-term PHI workloads we'd discuss Private deployment or Dedicated (VPC + custom KMS).

Next steps
- Can you confirm you want to proceed with a Hosted API PoC? If so: share the list of representative prompts and expected concurrency patterns and we’ll enable a temporary rate limit increase.
- Proposed follow-up: 30-min sync next week to confirm test vectors and timelines. I’m available Wed/Thu morning PT.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you set up.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood-quickstart.pdf, redwood-rate-limits.pdf, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

From: Chris Turner <chris.turner@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Paul Murray <paul.murray@acmehealth.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Hosted API evaluation follow-up — quickstart, endpoints, rate limits

Thanks Marissa — really helpful summary. A few quick answers / questions from our side: 

- We are leaning toward starting with Hosted API for the PoC to move fast. If the PoC looks good we'll evaluate Dedicated for predictable capacity and Private later if PHI handling requires it.
- Concurrency: our initial PoC traffic is low (50-100 concurrent), but we want to test up to 200 concurrent to validate bursting behavior. If you can enable the 200 req/sec bump for 2 weeks that would be ideal.
- Data retention & PHI: we need confirmation that logs can be disabled or retention reduced for specific API keys used in the PoC. Also would like a contact to run through SOC 2 specifics with our security team (Paul CC'd).
- Performance: do you have a sample SLO/latency baseline for the Hosted API (median P95 for short prompts at ~128 tokens)?

I'll also upload 10-15 representative prompts and a sample payload schema to the shared drive after the call.

Thanks,
Chris Turner
CTO, Acme Health
chris.turner@acmehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Chris Turner <chris.turner@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Paul Murray <paul.murray@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API evaluation follow-up — quickstart, endpoints, rate limits

Chris — perfect, thank you. Quick replies inline and next steps below.

- PoC & burst: we can enable a time-limited bump to 200 req/sec for your trial keys. I’ll coordinate with infra; please confirm the start date (suggest Mon Oct 26) and expected duration (2 weeks?).

- Data retention / logs: yes — we can disable request/response logging for specific API keys used in the PoC and set retention to 7 days. I'll have our security engagement (Dev) share the SOC 2 artifact and walk your security team through specifics.

- Performance baseline: for short prompts (~128 tokens) on Hosted API backed by our verified model profiles, typical observed medians are ~120-250ms and P95s under 600ms in US-West regions (dependent on prompt complexity and streaming). We include per-route latency breakdowns in the Console so you can correlate calls to SLAs.

- Next steps I’ll take today:
  1) Request temporary rate limit bump for your trial keys starting Mon Oct 26 — will confirm when enabled.
  2) Share a link to the SOC 2 contact/packet and connect Dev with Paul for a 30-min security sync.
  3) Drop a calendar invite for a 30-min technical kickoff (Wed Oct 28 / Thu Oct 29 morning PT) — I’ll include a short agenda: quickstart walkthrough, representative prompts, desired metrics, and success criteria.

If that timeline works, I’ll proceed.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
